title: 第24章 林若渊第25章 狠辣无情
slug: 我在玄幻世界召唤奇物
content_zh:
李大海嘿嘿一笑，不好意思的说道：“是这样的，你们也知道，自从我儿子到卧虎帮做事，经常不回来。”
“我一个人待着也无聊，所以就想着认个干女儿。虽然我还没问她愿不愿意。”
话还没说完，就被孙千打断：“等等，老李啊，你什么时候认的干女儿啊，我怎么不知道！”
“别急啊，你听我慢慢说。”
原来昨天晚上李大海本来已经打算关门休息了，没想到一个女的倒在了药铺门口。
夜深人静的，其他伙计已经回家休息了，一个人就这么倒在门口，吓了李大海一跳。
然后壮起胆子走上前去，因为是面部着地，所以李大海看不清楚她的脸。
只知道是个衣服破旧的女人，本着治病救人的目的，就把人背回了药铺。
等放在平时病人躺的床上，才看清楚，这是一个年纪轻轻的小姑娘，脸上带有血迹跟淤青，嘴唇干裂，手上也满是伤痕跟泥土。
“这...这谁干啊，对一个小姑娘都能下这么重的手。”
李大海急忙去打清水清洗伤口，等拿着清水回来的时候，小姑娘已经醒了，面无表情的盯着他。
看到小姑娘已经醒了，李大海拿着装满清水的盆说道：“小姑娘你醒啦，你这伤是怎么受的啊，家里人呢？”
小姑娘没有说话，还是一脸面无表情的盯着他。
随即想到小姑娘大半夜倒在门口，不是孤儿的话，说不定这伤就是家里人打出来的。
所以也就不再提伤是怎么来的了，只是把水盆放在一边说道：“你的伤口需要清洗，不然会感染的。”
小姑娘这才把目光放在水盆上。
“谢谢。”
听到小姑娘的谢谢，李大海也是满脸笑容说道：“没事，来，清洗一下伤口。”
说着就要上前帮忙清洗伤口，但不等李大海上前，小姑娘就把手放在水盆里清洗起来。
两手清洗间，手上因为伤痕起皮的地方重新被掀了起来，还有扩大的趋势，依稀可见皮肤下面的肉，但小姑娘像是感觉不到疼痛一样，依旧面无表情。

李大海急忙上前说道：“别这样清洗，容易让伤口更加严重的，”
不过等说完，小姑娘手也已经清洗好了，看着小姑娘手上重新流出鲜血的伤口，李大海满是心疼。
要怎么样的经历，才能让一个年纪轻轻的小姑娘变成这一副模样啊！
没等李大海细想，已经洗好手的小姑娘抬头看着他。
“你等我下，我去去就回。”说完李大海就出了药铺，向隔壁店铺走去。
咚咚敲门声响起。
没过一会脚步声响起，首饰铺的老板娘打开了门，看着李大海疑惑的说道：“怎么了李掌柜，大晚上的不睡觉。”
李大海赶忙说起了来由，首饰铺的老板娘一听说道：“那还愣着干嘛，走，去看看。”
等来到药铺里面，老板娘看着眼前伤痕累累的小姑娘心疼的说道：“哎呦，谁干的啊，对一个小姑娘这样。”
李大海摇了摇头：“不清楚，小姑娘也没说，不过先不聊这个，我去拿药，等下你帮她上下药。”
老板娘点了点头：“好，你去吧。”
等两人忙完，老板娘看着已经包扎好伤口的小姑娘问道：“你家里人呢？住哪里呀，我帮你去找他们。”
小姑娘看了老板娘一会，开口说道：“死了。”
短短两字，让李大海跟老板娘都沉默了。
两人对视一眼，低声说道：“老李，最近我们这边都挺太平的呀，没听过有谁死了啊。”
“不会是海鲸帮那群人吧，我听说海鲸帮这两天在其他地方，可是对不少人动手了。”
“很有可能，那这小姑娘不就成孤儿了嘛。”
李大海想了一会对着小姑娘说道：“要不你就留在我这边，当个药童，打打下手。”
content_en:
Li Dahai smiled and said sheepishly: "That's it. You all know that since my son went to work for the Crouching Tiger Gang, he often doesn't come back."
"I'm bored being alone, so I'm thinking of adopting a goddaughter. Although I haven't asked her if she is willing."
Before he finished speaking, he was interrupted by Sun Qian: "Wait a minute, Lao Li, when did you recognize your goddaughter? Why didn't I know!"
"Don't be anxious, just listen to me slowly."
It turned out that Li Dahai had planned to close the door and take a rest last night, but unexpectedly a woman collapsed at the door of the drug store.
It was late at night, and the other guys had gone home to rest. A man fell at the door, which shocked Li Dahai.
Then she plucked up the courage to step forward. Because she landed on her face, Li Dahai couldn't see her face clearly.
All I knew was that she was a woman in shabby clothes. With the purpose of treating illnesses and saving people, she carried her back to the pharmacy.
When she was placed on the bed where patients usually lay, she could see clearly that she was a young girl with bloodstains and bruises on her face, chapped lips, and her hands were covered with scars and dirt.
"This... who could do this? He could do such a heavy hand to a little girl."
Li Dahai hurriedly went to get some water to clean the wound. When he came back with the water, the little girl was already awake and staring at him expressionlessly.
Seeing that the little girl had woken up, Li Dahai took a basin filled with water and said, "Little girl, you are awake. How did you get this injury? Where are your family members?"
The little girl didn't speak, but still stared at him with an expressionless face.
Then he thought that the little girl collapsed at the door in the middle of the night. If she was not an orphan, the injury might have been caused by a family member.
So I stopped mentioning how the injury came about. I just put the basin aside and said, "Your wound needs to be cleaned, otherwise it will become infected."
The little girl then focused her attention on the basin.
"Thank you."
Hearing the little girl's thanks, Li Dahai said with a smile on his face: "It's okay, come on, clean the wound."
As she said this, she was about to step forward to help clean the wound, but before Li Dahai came forward, the little girl put her hands in the basin and started cleaning them.
While washing her hands, the skinned area on her hands due to scars was lifted up again, and it was tending to expand. The flesh under the skin was vaguely visible, but the little girl seemed to feel no pain and remained expressionless.
Li Dahai hurriedly stepped forward and said: "Don't clean it like this, it will easily make the wound more serious."
But by the time he finished speaking, the little girl's hands had already been cleaned. Seeing the wounds on the little girl's hands that were bleeding again, Li Dahai felt heartbroken.
What kind of experience does it take to make a young girl look like this!
Before Li Dahai could think about it, the little girl who had already washed her hands looked up at him.
"You wait for me to get off, I'll go and come back." After saying that, Li Dahai left the drug store and walked to the store next door.
There was a knock on the door.
After a while, footsteps sounded, and the proprietress of the jewelry shop opened the door, looked at Li Dahai and said doubtfully: "What's wrong, shopkeeper Li, I don't sleep at night."
Li Dahai quickly talked about the reason. Upon hearing this, the proprietress of the jewelry shop said: "Then why are you still standing there? Let's go and have a look."
When they arrived at the drug store, the proprietress looked at the scarred little girl in front of her and said distressedly: "Oh, who did this to a little girl?"
Li Dahai shook his head: "I don't know, the little girl didn't say anything, but let's not talk about it for now. I'll get the medicine. You can help her take the medicine later."
The landlady nodded: "Okay, go ahead."
After the two of them finished their work, the proprietress looked at the little girl who had bandaged the wound and asked: "Where are your family members? Where do they live? I will help you find them."
The little girl looked at the landlady for a while and then said, "He's dead."
With just two words, both Li Dahai and the landlady fell silent.
The two looked at each other and whispered: "Old Li, it’s been pretty peaceful here recently, I haven’t heard of anyone dying. "
"It can't be those people from the Sea Whale Gang. I heard that the Sea Whale Gang has been in other places in the past two days, but they have attacked many people. "
"It's very possible, then this little girl will become an orphan. "
Li Dahai thought for a while and said to the little girl: "How about you stay with me, be a medicine boy, and help me. "
